seo.title: DocYantra | Document processing inside DocKosha Cloud
seo.description: DocYantra is the private document-processing engine that powers DocKosha Cloud’s validated Office and PDF workflows.

hero.title: DocYantra powers DocKosha Cloud
hero.subtitle: A private, high-performance document processor for DocKosha Cloud’s supported Office and PDF workflows. Work outside its validated envelope fails closed.

highlights.title: Rust performance for managed processing
highlights.description: DocYantra provides a high-performance processing path for managed DocKosha Cloud workflows, with supported documents typically ready in seconds. DocKosha uses the mandatory direct DocYantra dependency.
bullets: The DocYantra validated path does not use a headless office suite or browser in the path
DocYantra uses isolated worker threads with finite deadlines and bounded queues
DocYantra validates output before it reaches the viewer

highlights.title: Multilingual, high-fidelity output
highlights.description: DocYantra can produce validated PDFs with compact glyph-subset fonts embedded, and resolve fonts on demand for math, symbol, and CJK coverage in supported Office documents.
bullets: DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, and XLSM conversion to PDF, plus CSV and Markdown rendering
Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text renders through pan-CJK Noto fonts
PDF merge, watermarking, and redaction through the DocYantra processing path

highlights.title: Fail-closed governance
highlights.description: DocYantra is built for controlled sharing where unvalidated output is not acceptable — anything outside the validated envelope fails closed with typed, stable error codes.
bullets: No silent quality loss and no tofu or placeholder glyphs
Converted assets are published only after output validation
The original remains available when preview conversion fails

pillars.title: Built for controlled sharing
points: Validated, deterministic DocYantra PDF output feeds DocKosha viewing, watermarking, redaction, and analytics.
DocYantra worker isolation keeps heavy document operations bounded by finite deadlines.
DocYantra’s compact glyph-subset fonts keep viewer PDFs lean without sacrificing fidelity.

pillars.title: Clear format boundaries
points: The DocYantra path converts modern DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, and XLSM files to PDF and renders CSV and Markdown.
Legacy .doc, .ppt, and .xls files and unsupported document features are rejected with typed errors.
CJK text in supported Office documents is supported; vertical text layout is not and fails closed.

steps.name: Validate the file
steps.summary: DocKosha checks the format, size, and processing envelope before any document work begins.

steps.name: Convert in an isolated worker
steps.summary: The DocYantra worker converts the document within a finite deadline; unsupported work returns a typed failure.

steps.name: Publish validated output
steps.summary: Only a validated PDF becomes the viewer asset; failed conversions fail closed and leave the original available.

cta.title: Bring blazing-fast, high-fidelity processing to your next data room
cta.subtitle: DocYantra powers supported modern document formats and controlled, PDF-first delivery inside DocKosha Cloud. It is not a standalone product or externally available engine package.
